intro.text: A highlady in Highprince Ruthar's court who moved to the Shattered Plains, leaving her husband at home to manage their lands.

items.text: A supporter of Ruthar and Sadeas, Sivi disliked House Kholin, more so after Adolin's duels shamed Ruthar and Aladar. At a feast after news of Dalinar's visions spread, she was handing out leaflets mocking him while talking with Highprince Vamah, scowled when Dalinar tried to talk tactics with Vamah, and half-heartedly hid the leaflets.
